verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not name @solidjs/router directly, but references to official routing come only via SolidStart, and one hands-on community report says 'SolidStart routing (occasionally very slow, no workaround, no support)' [solid-comm-12], indicating a first-party routing solution exists but has real friction. There's no first-party documentation in this pack describing a dedicated router API, seamless integration guarantees, or independent corroboration beyond that single complaint. missing for 10: first-party docs naming/describing the official router package, evidence of seamless integration claims, independent corroboration beyond one critical anecdote.
